description: A Georeferenced Incident-Level Road Traffic Crash Dataset for Nigeria (2015–2024) is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This is an artificial intelligence (AI)-ready dataset of road traffic crash (RTC) incidents in Nigeria extracted from RTC news reports published between October 2015 and July, 2024. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Road traffic, Road transport, Road safety, Traffic accident, Artificial intelligence. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
